school_website_about.history:
Founded in 2008, our school began as a small primary programme with a big vision: to offer affordable, high-quality education rooted in discipline, creativity, and service.

Over the years we have grown into a full basic school serving Primary and Junior High pupils, while keeping the close-knit community feel that families love.
school_website_about.vision: To be a leading community school where every child discovers their potential and graduates prepared for senior high and life beyond.
school_website_about.mission: To deliver excellent, values-based education through dedicated teaching, strong partnerships with parents, and a safe environment that celebrates effort and integrity.
school_website_about.director_message:
Welcome to our school. It is my privilege to lead a community where children are not just taught — they are known, encouraged, and challenged to become their best selves.

We believe education is a partnership. Together with parents and staff, we create a culture of high expectations, warm support, and real joy in learning. I invite you to visit us, meet our teachers, and see what makes our school special.
school_website_about.institution_overview:
Today we serve over one hundred learners across three classes, supported by a team of qualified teachers and caring staff. Our campus blends modern classrooms with spaces for sports, arts, and collaborative learning.

We use ScholarNerve to keep parents connected — from fees and attendance to report cards and school announcements.

school_website_admission_config.requirements:
Admission requirements

  • Completed online application form
  • Certified copy of birth certificate or Ghana Card
  • Two recent passport photographs
  • Previous school report card (if transferring)
  • Immunisation record (for new entrants)

Assessment & placement

Applicants may be invited for a short placement assessment in English and Mathematics. Final class placement is determined by age, prior records, and assessment results.

Fees

Term fees and payment options are shared upon acceptance. Need-based arrangements may be discussed with the finance office.

school_website_contact.working_hours: Mon–Fri: 7:30 AM – 3:30 PM | Sat: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Admissions)

school_website_team_members.bio: With over fifteen years in education, I am committed to building a school where every child feels seen, supported, and inspired to excel.
Ensuring smooth day-to-day operations and a welcoming front office for pupils, parents, and visitors.
Transparent fee management and friendly support for families navigating payments and receipts.
Passionate about literacy and helping pupils find their voice through reading and writing.
Making numbers make sense — from foundational skills to exam readiness.
Class 4 form teacher guiding pupils with care, structure, and high expectations.
Bringing language and culture alive through conversation, song, and project work.
Hands-on experiments and inquiry that spark curiosity about the world.
Equipping learners with digital skills for school projects and the future.

school_websites.tagline: Nurturing confident learners, grounded in character and ready for tomorrow.
school_websites.welcome_text: We are a vibrant learning community in the heart of Accra — where every pupil is known by name, challenged to grow, and supported to excel academically and personally.

highlights.title: Strong academics
highlights.description: Rigorous curriculum across English, Mathematics, Science, and more — with term reports parents can access online.

highlights.title: Dedicated teachers
highlights.description: Experienced educators who know each learner, track progress closely, and partner with families.

highlights.title: Holistic development
highlights.description: Sports, creative arts, ICT, and leadership programmes that build confidence beyond the classroom.

highlights.title: Caring community
highlights.description: A safe, welcoming campus where pupils feel valued, supported, and inspired to do their best.
